Commentary.Commentary: It will be New Zealand to bat first in the Super Over. The Sri Lanka players make their way out to the middle. Daryl Mitchell and James Neesham will open the innings for New Zealand. Maheesh Theekshana has been given the task of bowling the Super Over. Here we go...

We are heading to a Super Over, folks! Unreal scenes at Eden Park! Ish Sodhi is pumped and so are the New Zealand fans. On the other hand, Sri Lanka are dejected but now need to focus on what's ahead for them.

SIX! UP UP UP AND OVER THE FENCE FOR A MAXIMUM! We have a super over on the cards here. Over-pitched delivery in middle, Ish Sodhi times this to perfection right from the meat of his bat way over the head of deep mid-wicket fielder for a maximum. Super over follows.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and angling in on off, Tom Latham pushes it back to Maheesh Theekshana.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Tom Latham, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Nicely played! Darted in full and at the pads, Tom Latham sweeps it in the air but in the vacant backward square leg region for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Tom Latham, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Full and tailing into the batter, Daryl Mitchell shimmies down the track and drives it to mid off for a quick single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and shaping away on off, Tom Latham hangs back and blocks it out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Dilshan Madushanka to Tom Latham, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Daryl Mitchell taps it towards point and takes a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Dilshan Madushanka to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! SHOT! Full and at the stumps by Dilshan Madushanka, Daryl Mitchell picks the length early and lofts it with a straight bat. Clears the long on fence for a maximum.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Dilshan Madushanka to Daryl Mitchell, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Full and angling across on off, Daryl Mitchell steers this one towards third man. Two fielders perform the chase and save a run for their side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Dilshan Madushanka to Daryl Mitchell, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length this time and on off, Daryl Mitchell stays back and keeps it out on the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Dilshan Madushanka to Daryl Mitchell, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Daryl Mitchell walks out next.

OUT! BOWLED! Dilshan Madushanka gets into the act now! Starts with a length delivery at the stumps and the ball nips back in after pitching. Chad Bowes does not account for the inward movement as he tried to defend. The ball sneaks through the gate and crashes onto the stumps. This is some start for Sri Lanka and not so, for New Zealand.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Dilshan Madushanka to Chad Bowes, OUT! b Dilshan Madushanka.

Commentary.Commentary: Dilshan Madushanka shares the attack with Maheesh Theekshana for the visitors.
Full and at the pads, Chad Bowes clips it through square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Maheesh Theekshana to Chad Bowes, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short and angled in on off from 'round the wicket, Tom Latham hangs back to defend but gets an inside edge. The ball rolls to backward square leg and Latham opens his account with a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Maheesh Theekshana to Tom Latham, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Tom Latham walks out next.

OUT! LBW! Maheesh Theekshana strikes and removes Tim Seifert! Bowls this one full and at the stumps, Tim Seifert plants his foot forward and looks to clip this one on the leg side. He gets beaten by the trajectory and the ball strikes him on the front toe. Sri Lanka go up in unison and the umpire raises the finger. Tim Seifert has a word with Chad Bowes but eventually runs out of time and has to make his way back.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Maheesh Theekshana to Tim Seifert, OUT! lbw b Maheesh Theekshana.

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and at the stumps, Tim Seifert pulls out the reverse sweep and wears it on the gloves.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Maheesh Theekshana to Tim Seifert, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed through quicker, short and outside off, Tim Seifert tries to push it on the off side but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Maheesh Theekshana to Tim Seifert, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Chad Bowes and New Zealand are underway! Fullish delivery outside off, Chad Bowes drives it crisply and wide of mid off. Chamika Karunaratne dives to his left and keeps it to one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Maheesh Theekshana to Chad Bowes, 1 run.
